database_realtime_suite.command: AERALYTH_DATABASE_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 DATABASE_URL=<isolated audit database> cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --locked realtime::tests -- --nocapture

database_realtime_suite.timing_definition: Elapsed from cohort startup through initial authorization update, including connection setup. This is not SQL-only latency.
database_realtime_suite.revocation: A deleted session was detected by the second periodic batch without a notification listener, before the five-second authorization deadline. Another session of that user and unrelated user sessions remained authorized.
database_realtime_suite.limits: Real database and in-process server subscriptions, not 2048 HTTP sockets. Batch query count was asserted. A sustained idle whole-database QPS measurement was not performed by this group.

collection_isolation.coverage: A 30-second pg_sleep on the collection connection does not block realtime_dispatch on its separate connection. Shutdown cancels SQL; SELECT 1 on the same collection connection completes within 250 ms.

coverage: zero expired backlog after each bounded steady-probe pass
pruning.limits: Local SQL service-capacity probe with alternating write/prune batches, not a production concurrent writer capacity guarantee.
